title: Crowdstrike’s Talks With Zscaler Show AI-Led Cyber Consolidation
html:
A wave of multibillion-dollar takeovers is reshaping the cybersecurity industry as the biggest companies race to expand their defenses against increasingly sophisticated attacks powered by artificial intelligence.

CrowdStrike Holdings Inc.’s talks to acquire Zscaler Inc. in what could be one of the industry’s largest deals would bring together two major players in different corners of the $244 billion security market, accelerating a shift toward a smaller number of companies protecting more of the world’s computers and networks.

The two companies are discussing a potential combination that could come together soon, Bloomberg News reported on Friday. Deliberations are ongoing, ...
